source_name: Офіційне інтернет-представництво Президента України — підписані закони
why_relevant: The final procedural gate between adoption and entry into force: signature, or veto/повернуто з підписом (return with proposals). Confirmed in practice for Law No. 1591-IX 'Про платіжні послуги'. Signature date drives the publication date and hence the effective date.

source_name: Офіційні друковані видання — «Голос України», «Урядовий кур'єр», «Офіційний вісник України», «Відомості Верховної Ради України»
why_relevant: Under Presidential Decree No. 503/1997, official publication in these outlets is the legal trigger for entry into force; 'Голос України' is the Rada's own gazette and is where a law's official publication date — the date most entry-into-force clauses count from — is fixed. Indispensable for computing exact deadlines rather than inferring them.

source_name: НБУ — комунікації щодо парламентських рішень (bank.gov.ua news)
why_relevant: The regulator publicly reacts to Rada steps ('Верховна Рада підтримала законопроєкт щодо відновлення кредитування у першому читанні'; adoption of the Law on Payment Services), usually naming the bill number and explaining the supervisory consequences and the implementing acts the NBU will now have to issue. This is the bridge from this cell's primary-legislation signal to the regulator-act workstream.

source_name: BRDO Tech Hub — боти підписок на оновлення комітетів ВРУ та аналіз пояснювальних записок
why_relevant: Civic-tech toolkit built on Rada data: subscription bots for Verkhovna Rada committee updates, automated analysis of explanatory notes, and an EU-directive translation service. A ready-made alerting layer over exactly this cell's committee stage, and a pointer to further Rada-data tooling.

source_name: «Онлайн-моніторинг» — урядова діджитал-платформа моніторингу законодавства
source_subtype: government announcement pointing to a monitoring platform
why_relevant: Government-announced platform for one-click legislation monitoring; the announcement page is the pointer to the live service and to how the executive itself tracks legislative change. Worth resolving to the actual platform URL and assessing coverage of financial-sector acts.

source_name: Законотворчість — Інформаційні листи (informList)
why_relevant: Procedural information letters attached to the bill pipeline (e.g. distribution to deputies, referral notes). A less-known Rada publication surface that documents intermediate procedural steps not always reflected on the bill card summary.

source_name: Законопроєкти, подані суб'єктом права законодавчої ініціативи (per-MP bill lists)
why_relevant: Initiator-centric view of the register. Lets the pipeline be watched through the small set of MPs who reliably author banking/payments bills (notably the finance committee leadership), catching drafts whose titles do not contain obvious keywords.

source_name: ІПС «Законодавство України» — Публікації документа (Офіційний вісник України)
source_subtype: official legal information system / gazette index
why_relevant: Verkhovna Rada's legal information system indexes acts by the issue of Офіційний вісник України in which they were officially published. This is the practical machine-reachable way to obtain the authoritative publication date (from which legal deadlines run) for CMU resolutions, MinFin orders and NBU acts, without a paid gazette subscription.

source_name: ІПС «Законодавство України» — Публікації документа (Урядовий кур'єр)
source_subtype: official legal information system / gazette index
why_relevant: Same index but for Урядовий кур'єр, the daily newspaper of the central executive authorities which is also an official publication vehicle. Many CMU resolutions get their operative publication date here before or alongside the gazette, so it is the second authoritative timestamp channel.

source_name: Урядовий кур'єр — газета центральних органів виконавчої влади України
why_relevant: The daily official newspaper of the executive branch. Its 'Офіційно' section carries the published texts of laws and CMU acts; the issue date on the paper is the legally operative publication date for many acts. Also carries announcements (tenders, appointments, state bank supervisory board competitions) that never surface elsewhere.

source_name: Кабінет Міністрів України — Пошук серед актів Уряду (npasearch)
why_relevant: The government portal's own act database is the fastest channel for newly adopted CMU постанови and розпорядження — including binding acts on cashless-payment obligations for merchants, state bank governance, cash circulation and treasury payments that never appear on the NBU site. Adoption date here, publication date from the gazette.

source_name: Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine — Search for Government decisions (EN)
why_relevant: English-language mirror of the CMU act search and news feed. Useful for English-language monitoring and for disambiguating official English renderings of Ukrainian act titles, though coverage is partial versus the Ukrainian side.

source_name: Міністерство фінансів України — Накази Міністерства фінансів (per-year index)
why_relevant: MinFin's own year-by-year index of its накази. MinFin orders bind treasury payment procedures, budget-institution payroll and pension crediting through authorised banks, public-sector accounting standards and audit regulation — binding on banks yet entirely outside NBU publication channels. The per-year URL pattern makes systematic backfill and forward monitoring straightforward.

source_name: Міністерство фінансів України — Банки державного сектору
why_relevant: MinFin acts as the shareholder-of-record for Ukraine's state banks (Приватбанк, Ощадбанк, Укрексімбанк, Укргазбанк). This section carries the state banking sector strategy, supervisory board competitions, privatisation and governance decisions — a policy stream that is executive, not supervisory, and therefore absent from NBU sources.

source_name: Єдиний державний реєстр нормативно-правових актів (Реєстр НПА, Мін'юст)
why_relevant: The Ministry of Justice register is the authoritative record of state-registered normative acts, including the section 'Опублікування в офіційних виданнях' that records exactly where and when each act was officially published. For A3 deadline tracking this is the closest thing to a canonical publication-date ledger. Governed by CMU resolution 359-2024-п on register access.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — набір даних «Єдиний державний реєстр нормативно-правових актів»
why_relevant: Machine-readable open-data export of the Ministry of Justice register — act cards and texts released as public information explicitly permitted for free reuse. This is the lowest-friction bulk path to registration and publication metadata, bypassing the legacy register UI.

source_name: Портал відкритих даних Верховної Ради — ІПС «Законодавство України» datasets
why_relevant: Bulk XML/JSON/TXT exports of Ukrainian legislation and legal terminology from the parliament's legal information system. Provides a scrape-free route to act texts and metadata that would otherwise require hitting the bot-defended zakon.rada.gov.ua front end.

source_name: Державна казначейська служба України — нормативно-правова база та накази
why_relevant: The Treasury is the executive-branch payment operator for the state budget and issues its own накази on payment execution, supporting documents for budget obligations, and treasury servicing — operationally binding on banks handling budget flows. It also has a dedicated Управління платіжних систем. None of this is NBU-published.

source_name: Голос України — офіційне друковане видання Верховної Ради України
why_relevant: The third official publication vehicle. Laws (including the payments-services and banking laws that CMU/MinFin acts implement) take their operative publication date from Голос України as often as from the gazette, and it holds a complete issue archive back to 1991 for retrospective deadline reconstruction.

source_name: ДП «Преса» — передплата на «Офіційний вісник України» (журнал, on-line, off-line, «зі змінами»)
why_relevant: Documents the actual commercial access routes to the gazette itself: print (subscription index 40433), electronic/CD (index 48345), on-line and a consolidated 'зі змінами' edition. Establishes that a fully authoritative gazette feed is a paid product and identifies which SKU to buy if verbatim gazette text is required.

source_name: Державна регуляторна служба України (ДРС)
why_relevant: The regulatory gatekeeper: draft regulatory acts (including MinFin and other executive drafts touching financial services) must be published with a regulatory impact analysis and given a public-consultation window, and DRS can refuse approval where that was skipped. Its weekly digests of business-relevant draft regulations are an early-warning feed ahead of adoption and gazette publication.

source_name: Міністерство економіки та довкілля України — Повідомлення про оприлюднення проєктів регуляторних актів
why_relevant: Canonical worked example of the mandatory ministry-level 'notice of publication of a draft regulatory act' page. The same tag-based document-list pattern recurs across ministries, so it is the template for locating MinFin's and other ministries' consultation feeds — the pre-adoption stage of the A3 timeline.

source_name: Міністерство юстиції України — офіційні періодичні видання (regional Minjust explainers)
why_relevant: Regional Ministry of Justice offices publish plain-language explanations of which publications count as official, what the legal effect of publication is, and what the chronological/alphabetical indices to the gazette are. Useful for encoding correct deadline rules into the collection pipeline rather than guessing.

source_name: Вісник. Офіційно про податки / document.vobu.ua — трекер постанов КМУ
why_relevant: A specialist Ukrainian publisher maintaining a dated, categorised feed of CMU resolutions. Useful as a redundant, easier-to-parse mirror for detecting new CMU acts when kmu.gov.ua listing changes shape, and it often surfaces acts before commentary appears elsewhere.

source_name: Державна податкова служба України — Постанови Кабінету Міністрів України (тематична добірка)
why_relevant: An executive agency's own curated subset of CMU resolutions it must apply. Useful as a relevance filter — it shows which CMU acts an operational agency treats as binding, including those touching cash registers, cashless settlement obligations for merchants and reporting, which sit at the banking/payments boundary.

source_name: Кабінет Міністрів України — новинна стрічка урядових рішень (kmu.gov.ua/news)
why_relevant: The government press feed announces decisions on the day of the Cabinet meeting, days to weeks before the act text and gazette publication appear. It is the earliest reliable signal that a banking/payments-relevant CMU act exists, and it names the responsible ministry — which tells you which act repository to watch next.

source_name: НКЦПФР — Національна комісія з цінних паперів та фондового ринку (NSSMC) official site
why_relevant: Primary securities/capital-markets supervisor. Issues rішення (decisions) that bind banks acting as depositary institutions, custodians, traders, issuers of bonds, and PSP-adjacent investment firms. Bilingual (uk/en) mirror makes it tractable for automated tracking.

source_name: НКЦПФР — Regulations / Нормативна база
why_relevant: Consolidated listing of NSSMC normative acts — the authoritative place to detect newly adopted Положення and their entry-into-force dates (compliance deadlines for banks/professional participants).
